newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's property sector healthy, say consultants.
newsitem.headline: Manila's property sector healthy, say consultants.

text.p: Property consultants Cuervo Far East Inc and Richard Ellis said on Tuesday the Philippine property sector remains buoyant and is unlikely to follow the slump of Thailand's property market.

"The Philippines is not another Thailand. Despite all the rumours and spooks, Cuervo Far East/Richard Ellis believes that the property market in the Philippines is alive and well," Frederick Santos, Cuervo Far East country representative told a news conference.

Fears of oversupply in the sector have sent property stocks reeling. The property sub-index which has been on a downtrend since July last year fell to its year low on Tuesday closing at 1,324.94 points.
Santos said that unlike Thailand, interest rates in the Philippines are on a downtrend and bank loans to the property sector is below 10 percent compared to almost 25 percent of Thai banks.
The Thailand property sector, according to Santos, is heavily dependent on bank financing while in the Philippines, property firms resort to other debt instruments.
Santos said in the Philippine office market, demand will outpace supply in the next two years.

"While the Thai property sector is confined to Bangkok, we have other good prospects like Cebu, Iloilo, Davao, Cagayan de Oro, Iloilo, Iligan and General Santos in central and southern Philippines," Santos added.
